reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time and travel a lot, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag is the first thing that actually fits how I live. The empty-box guarantee and the named lab report make one box a low-risk try, especially at the $24.99 launch price.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I'm paying extra for the sachet format and I don't know yet if I'll actually remember to take it.
would_change_my_mind: If the box stayed at $29.99 with no launch price, I would probably pass and stay with a cheaper bottle I can keep in my bag.
